dedupe_keys.name: wesys waste to energy system simulation

description: WESyS Waste-to-Energy System Simulation is published by National Laboratory of the Rockies. WESyS uses system dynamics to model waste-to-energy industry development under technology, policy and investment scenarios. Its stated coverage is United States, split into California and the rest of the country. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The full-resource cost is unknown and requires provider clarification. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Long-term system-dynamics scenarios are not forecasts of individual facility performance. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
